plugins.name: unfetch
plugins.description: Connect your AI assistant to Google Ads, Meta Ads for Facebook, Instagram, and Messenger, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Search Console. Build cross-channel marketing reports and analyze PPC campaigns, ad spend, CPC, conversions, traffic, and SEO. Run keyword research, competitor analysis, landing-page analysis, and web research across connected brands. Includes private memory for reporting preferences.
